title: Dither
description: Render an animated dithered surface (gradient, glow, noise, waves, plasma, ripples or a custom GLSL field) in theme colours, with an optional title.
author: Harald Bregu

field.description: Optional GLSL defining float field(vec2 uv, vec2 res, float t) that returns a tone in [0, 1]. Replaces pattern.

title.description: Optional heading. Omit when no title is needed.

colors.description: Ink colours from light to dense tones: palette names (ink, blue, purple, green, pink, orange, red, grey) or CSS colours. Default ["ink"].

cell.description: Dot size in CSS pixels. Default 3.

animate.description: false holds a still frame. Default true.
